## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slim sixteen-year-old girl who is skinny with thin, ungracefully long legs and a pale face marked by seven freckles on her nose. She has serious, luminous gray eyes and pale, ever-changing rose cheeks. Her hair, which friends call auburn, is notoriously red—at times described as [Titian](../character/titian.md)—though it was once cut short and shingled after a incident turned it green, leaving her with short, silky curls before growing back into a long braid or glossy, tumbled locks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P0](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P12](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P39](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P13](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER X. ## Personality

A talkative and imaginative individual, she possesses a vivid mind prone to daydreaming, which can lead to moments of impulsive heedlessness. Despite these distracted tendencies, she proves to be ambitious, quick to learn, and remarkably skilled at reciting poetry and connecting with children. Driven by a deep desire to be loved by everyone, her motivations include adding beauty to life, bringing joy to others, and striving for academic success. She works hard to pass examinations high, aiming to excel for the sake of [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) while determinedly seeking to surpass [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Her ambitions further include becoming a teacher, winning the Avery scholarship to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), though she is still susceptible to simple fears, such as a dread of the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) after nightfall.

## History

Born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), Anne Shirley was an orphan girl who lived in [Marysville](../codex/places.md#marysville) with Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) until age eight, spent over two years with Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md), and came from an asylum before being taken in by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). As a child, she habitually talked to herself, was raised by hand, and once peeled the skin off her nose trying to remove her freckles. Over time, she accidentally served [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) currant wine, fell from a roof after taking a dare, dyed her hair green, and lost her boat while playing Elaine, but she eventually excelled in school, won a scholarship to [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), and gave up her higher education to stay home and teach in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) died. Now nineteen, Anne helped form the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), whom she once struck with a slate as a child and later reconciled with after he gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school for her. While continuing her teaching career and helping [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) raise the orphaned Keith twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), Anne navigated local mishaps, such as accidentally selling her neighbor Mr. Harrison's cow and accidentally dying her nose red. She eventually brought [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) and Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) together, facilitating their eventual romance. As her close friend [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) questioned her about her romantic feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), Anne denied having any while reaffirming her deep, lifelong bond with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

## Quotes

> "You would cry, too, if you were an orphan and had come to a place you thought was going to be home and found that they didn’t want you because you weren’t a boy. Oh, this is the most tragical thing that ever happened to me!"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P11](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0011)

> "but, oh, please do call me Cordelia. It can’t matter much to you what you call me if I’m only going to be here a little while, can it? And Anne is such an unromantic name."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P19](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0019)

> "why didn’t you tell me at the station that you didn’t want me and leave me there? If I hadn’t seen the White Way of Delight and the Lake of Shining Waters it wouldn’t be so hard."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0025)

> "She brought Lily Jones for herself. Lily is only five years old and she is very beautiful and had nut-brown hair. If I was very beautiful and had nut-brown hair would you keep me?"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P29](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0029)

> "Pretty well. I’m better at looking after children, though. I’ve had so much experience at that. It’s such a pity you haven’t any here for me to look after."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P24](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0024)

## Relationships

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md) is Avonlea's minister who, along with his wife, maintains a supportive relationship with Anne. Although Anne's initial attempt to host them at tea ended in disaster when she accidentally flavored a cake with liniment, the couple warmly overlooked the mistake. Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md) approves of Anne's choices and offers a welcoming presence in her social circle.
